scope: Proposition 4.3 (Partitions with separated rows) of the manuscript “Counterexamples to the duality conjecture for metric entropy” (preprints/Counterexamples-to-the-duality-conjecture-for-metric-entropy-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 329 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 6d6f9d0518a6e50d), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 11. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: With the parameters and directions of Proposi- tion 4.2, let 𝑋 = Symℎ (𝐸* ), 𝐿𝑖(𝑥) = 𝑥(𝑡𝑖, ·, . . . , ·), and let 𝒯 = {𝑇 ⊆ [𝑢] : |[𝑢] ∖ 𝑇| ≤ 𝜃𝑢}. Then |𝑋| = 𝑚 = 𝑝𝐷ℎ , and each label map 𝐿𝑖 has at most 𝑞 = 𝑝𝐷ℎ−1 realized labels. For the partition graphs of Section 3, every pair of distinct 𝑥, 𝑦 ∈ 𝑋 has some 𝑇 ∈ 𝒯 satisfying 𝑑𝑇 (𝑥, 𝑦) > ℎ. (4.8) Consequently, for 𝑌 = 𝑋 × 𝒯 and 𝑅𝑥 = (𝑔(𝑣,𝑇)(𝑥))(𝑣,𝑇)∈𝑌 ∈ R𝑌 , the rows satisfy ‖𝑅𝑥 − 𝑅𝑦‖∞ = 1 (𝑥 ̸= 𝑦). (4.9)
